integrity: Analytic spectral reduction and full universal proof; independent validation not performed. Finite numerical checks are corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: Three equally sized graph parts, one weighted cross edge in 1<t<=2, all other edges unit; no independent verification, no general multi-edge classification. The t=2 deletion case is a specialization of general unweighted graph-join QEC theory and is not claimed alone as novel.
title: Cubic roundness sensitivity of a single weighted tripartite edge
